settings.title: AI Data Contribution - In-App Data
settings.description: Controls whether Atlassian uses your organization's in-app data (titles, descriptions, comments from Jira, Confluence, JSM) to improve AI models. Effective August 17, 2026. Default ON for Free/Standard, OFF for Premium/Enterprise.
settings.default: ON for Free/Standard; OFF for Premium/Enterprise

settings.title: AI Data Contribution - Metadata
settings.description: Controls metadata contribution for AI. Always ON for Free/Standard/Premium — only Enterprise can disable. Metadata includes statistical patterns extracted from content.

settings.title: Enforce Two-Step Verification (2FA)
settings.description: Requires managed users to use TOTP or SMS as second factor. Users prompted at next login when enforced.

settings.title: Block User API Token Access
settings.description: Controls whether users can create/use API tokens. Default: allowed. Blocking prevents unauthorized programmatic access.

settings.title: Block User-Installed Apps
settings.description: Prevents non-admin users from installing Marketplace apps independently. Default: allowed.

settings.title: App Vendor Analytics/Log Access
settings.description: Controls whether installed apps share analytics and logs with vendors. Defaults to shared for 60 days on install.
